note: Pixel positions read by hand on 2-3x zoomed crops of the repo image (no pixels of the photograph are stored here). World points are twin-frame coordinates of the corresponding model features at the time of measurement (model version in 'model'). Fit set: gate (near, ~14 m) plus Teaching Block 1 window heads (far, ~120 m), so that focal length and distance separate; the far fit points use the Teaching Block 1 bay width and storey heights, whose absolute scale comes from the Esri eave width.
camera_model: pinhole, principal point column 1280 and row 1075 (horizon from the converging kerbs; the published image is keystone-corrected, i.e. a level camera with a shifted principal point); free: position (x, y, z), focal length, yaw, roll
model: gate.json / site.json / yihao.json as committed with this file
